scenes.setting: 29 Sivellaus Street, across from the Yard itself: a clown-painted intruder quizzes drunken Baronet Rafter Pound — faceless servants who searched the house for years — then Slumber-Charms him for dream-walking and spirit channeling; all answers ring true
scenes.text_anchor: His face was painted red, yellow, and white, looking like the funniest clown!

scenes.setting: After the window clicks shut, Rafter Pound's eyes snap open — ringed with ruptured capillaries — and fix on the open oriel window
scenes.text_anchor: Around those light blue eyes, there was a circle of ruptured capillaries!

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog with Rafter's stolen hairs: sidestepping the six gods' entanglement, Klein divines 'Rafter Pound's future' to confirm the past
